failure_signature: load reading climbs with tool speed, length of cable being dragged and wrap around posts; risk of exceeding 10 N ('fights back when you hurry')
when_to_apply: any dragging motion of the cable-holding tool
repair_strategy: advance a carrot along the planned path at v = vmin + (vmax - vmin) * clip((load_hi - load)/(load_hi - load_lo), 0, 1), cap the carrot lead over the tool's path projection, retreat 1 cm along the path if load > load_back
code_sketch: frac=clip((6.5-load)/(6.5-2.5),0,1); v=0.02+0.08*frac; s_cmd=min(s_cmd+v*dt, s_tool+0.03, S_end); if load>8: s_cmd=min(s_cmd,s_tool)-0.01
validated_by: lives 1-5 (max load 4.3-5.2 N, no overload); eval 50 episodes: 0 overloads, max load 5.32 N

failure_signature: post wound on the wrong side or not at all (sides_now != post_sides) / tool path through a post
when_to_apply: planning the tool route; cable point 1 is anchored at (0.05, 0) left of all posts and the route starts left of all posts
repair_strategy: side +1 (CCW, post on the left from point 1 to tool) = pass the post on its low-y side; side -1 = high-y side. Plan an x-monotone corridor path (elastic band clipped to circles of R=0.075 below/above each post); where the corridor is infeasible (posts overlapping in x with incompatible sides), Dijkstra on a 1 cm grid with each post's forbidden vertical half-line blocked and inflated circles (R 0.07 -> 0.06 -> 0.052), then string pulling
code_sketch: U=min(U, py-sqrt(R^2-(x-px)^2)) for side+1; L=max(L, py+sqrt(...)) for side-1; smooth+clip; if any L>U: grid with free &= ~(|x-px|<=0.75h & s*(y-py)>0)
validated_by: lives 1-5 all reached sides_ok=3 (life 2 seed 163 and life 4 seed 57 used the grid planner)

failure_signature: tool does not come to rest (|v|>0.02) inside 0.02 m
repair_strategy: once the carrot reaches the path end command the target itself every step; the position servo settles within 1-2 steps

failure_signature: tool sits exactly at the command, load at rest level (0.3-0.6 N), carrot never advances, time-out far from target (eval seeds 1029, 1033, 1046)
when_to_apply: any path parameterised on an x grid (corridor planner) or containing long segments, combined with vertex-only projection
repair_strategy: resample the planned path uniformly by arc length (4 mm) so every gap is far below the carrot lead; static check: max consecutive gap on the 200 snapshots dropped from 0.152 m (14 seeds > 0.03) to 0.004 m
validated_by: static geometry only (policy_v3, not flown, not submitted)
